_comment: Settings for the per-fund holdings analysis (analyse_a_fund.py). Every number here is an assumption a person should confirm - the flag below says nobody has yet. Changing a number here to make a chart look better is the exact failure india_planning_assumptions.json was built to prevent.
_risk_free_note: Standing in for the 91-day T-bill. Confirm the current rate on rbi.org.in and set verified_by_a_person to true.

target_allocation._comment: Asset-class TARGETS for build_the_portfolio_review.py's allocation-drift observation. These four numbers were placed by an agent as a reasonable starting point - NO person has chosen or confirmed them, so verified_by_a_person stays false and every drift figure built on them prints [UNVERIFIED]. The owner edits the numbers AND flips the flag only when the targets are genuinely theirs; changing a number here so the drift table flatters today's mix is exactly the failure this file's honesty rules exist to stop.

market_cap_thresholds_cr._note: SEBI defines caps by AMFI rank (top 100 / 101-250 / rest), which moves twice a year. Absolute crore thresholds are a standing approximation until somebody maps the AMFI lists - hence unverified.
